scripts.start: lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/commons && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/components && lerna run --stream --parallel --ignore @opencrvs/dashboards --ignore @opencrvs/mobile-proxy $OTHER_LERNA_FLAGS start
scripts.start2: lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/commons && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/components && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/toppan-common && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/toppan-db && lerna run --stream --parallel --ignore @opencrvs/dashboards --ignore @opencrvs/mobile-proxy $OTHER_LERNA_FLAGS start
scripts.compose:deps:demo: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-.env}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f docker-compose.demo-deps.yml up'
scripts.compose:deps-atg: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-atg.env}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs-atg}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f docker-compose.atg-deps.yml up'
scripts.compose:down:deps-atg: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-atg.env}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs-atg}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f docker-compose.atg-deps.yml down'
scripts.compose:family-tree: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-.env}; OVERLAY=${COMPOSE_DEPS_FILE:-docker-compose.dev-deps.yml}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f "$OVERLAY" up family-tree postgres -d'
scripts.rebuild:family-tree: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-.env}; OVERLAY=${COMPOSE_DEPS_FILE:-docker-compose.dev-deps.yml}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f "$OVERLAY" up family-tree postgres --build -d'
scripts.compose:opensearch: bash -c 'ENV_FILE=${COMPOSE_ENV_FILE:-.env}; OVERLAY=${COMPOSE_DEPS_FILE:-docker-compose.dev-deps.yml}; PROJECT=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-opencrvs}; docker compose --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -p "$PROJECT" -f docker-compose.deps.yml -f "$OVERLAY" up opensearch opensearch-dashboards -d'
scripts.build: lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/commons && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/components && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/toppan-common && lerna run build --scope @opencrvs/toppan-db && lerna run build --stream --sort && lerna run build-storybook
scripts.build:image: export VERSION=`git log -1 --pretty=format:%h` && docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION} -t opencrvs-build . && unset VERSION
scripts.dev:toppan: concurrently -k -r -n db,common,service "yarn workspace @opencrvs/toppan-db dev" "yarn workspace @opencrvs/toppan-common dev" "yarn workspace @opencrvs/toppan-service start"
